notes: ABR derived: Public Health Jersey Births & Breastfeeding Profile 2025 reports births to mothers aged <18 consistently <1% of all births over two decades (711 births in 2025, mean maternal age 33); scaled to women 15-19 gives ~4 per 1000, below England & Wales (GB WB 7.8).
childMarriage: Jersey law allows marriage at 16 with consent; under-18 marriages statistically negligible -> small real estimate 0.1%.
laborForceGap: no sex-split labour force series published for Jersey; derived from verified GB anchor (57.5% F vs 65.8% M, WB SL.TLF.CACT 2024 = -8.3), Jersey labour structure comparable to UK.
contraceptiveUse: no Jersey-specific survey; applied GB anchor value from WB SP.DYN.CONU.ZS (83, 1998 - latest available year for GBR).
ABR derived: INSEE Martinique has the lowest adolescent fertility of the French DOM; estimated as FR anchor (WB SP.ADO.TFRT 2024 = 3.3) x ~1.5 overseas-context ratio = 5.
childMarriage: French law sets minimum marriage age 18 (15 only with prosecutor consent, extremely rare); under-18 marriage negligible -> 0.1%.

laborForceGap derived from INSEE: DOM employment-rate gaps by sex (Insee Focus 8278271, avg 2021-2023) show Martinique closest to Hexagone; adjusted for sex-specific unemployment (INSEE, 14.5% F vs 10.5% M) gives participation gap ~ -5 pts.
contraceptiveUse: applied FR anchor from WB SP.DYN.CONU.ZS (74.6, 1994 - latest available year for FRA); no territory-specific survey exists.

ABR derived from INSEE Bilan demographique 2025 Mayotte (insee.fr/fr/statistiques/8743599): 9,070 births, 4.5% (410) to mothers under 18 incl. 100 to mothers under 16; INSEE reports cumulative fertility 15-24 of 1.1 children/woman vs 0.2 in Hexagone. Applying the observed ~15x amplification of teen vs metropolitan fertility gives ASF 15-19 ~60/1000; cross-check: ~480 teen births on ~8,000 women 15-19 is consistent with the 4.5% under-18 share.

childMarriage: legal under-18 marriages are rare (French law), but Mayotte's large Comorian-origin population (75% of mothers foreign-born, mostly Comorian) sustains documented customary/religious early unions; no official statistic exists -> real estimate 2.5%.

laborForceGap derived from INSEE Enquete Emploi Mayotte 2024 (insee.fr/fr/statistiques/8586371): employment rate 15-64 is 23% for women vs 42% for men (19-pt gap); adjusting for unemployment (29% overall, higher among women) gives labor-force participation gap ~ -20 pts.

contraceptiveUse: applied FR anchor from WB SP.DYN.CONU.ZS (74.6, 1994); NOTE actual prevalence in Mayotte is likely substantially lower than mainland France due to documented access barriers (PMI understaffing, large uninsured population) - no territory survey available.

childMarriage: England & Wales raised minimum marriage age to 18 in 2022, extended to Montserrat; under-18 marriage negligible -> 0.1%.

childMarriage: Niue follows NZ marriage law (minimum 18; 16 with court consent, rare); slight Pacific-context uplift -> 0.5%.
